info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Refinances-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Refinancing API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of available mortgage loan refinancing options. This endpoint is ideal for lenders, financial institutions, and consumers seeking to explore refinancing products and identify suitable financial solutions tailored to their needs. By accessing details about various refinancing options, users can make informed decisions regarding their mortgage management. The API streamlines the process of comparing loan terms and rates, enhancing the overall user experience in the mortgage refinancing sector.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch available options for refinancing their loans. It provides a streamlined method to explore various refinancing opportunities and details for each option.

requestBody.description: Request body to initiate a refinance operation for loans. This body should contain the necessary details for processing the refinance request, including loan identifiers and borrower information.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to loan refinance.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_202.title: Loan Refinance Response

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the refinance operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the refinance request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or message related to the operation.

ListMortgageLoansRefinancesResponse_202.description: Response schema for the loan refinance operation, detailing the status and result of the refinance request.
